description: This file defines a PHP trait 'ModelTrait' used for serializing model objects into arrays, including nested collections and attribute filtering, within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setFilters
methods.description: Sets the filter array specifying which attributes to include in serialization.

methods.name: setAttributeNames
methods.description: Overrides attribute names for output array.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Sets the model entity object to be serialized.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the entity into an array based on filters and attribute names, handling nested collections.

methods.name: makeNestedArray
methods.description: Creates nested arrays from a list of keys and a value.

methods.name: normalizeNestedCollection
methods.description: Normalizes a collection of objects into an array of associative arrays using specified getter methods.
